scope: shared b/i/e star overlay assets; three stars arranged one top and two bottom; no medal body baked in

images.name: 初级
images.layout: ONE star centered at x=50%, y=70% of the square canvas. No other star.
images.prompt: Create an independent reusable DIFFICULTY STAR OVERLAY asset by editing the supplied reference. The reference is a supporting STYLE/SHAPE reference for the existing GOLD FIVE-POINT STARS only. REMOVE the ENTIRE ascending arrow, ALL angular arrow fragments and every other part of the medal. The output must contain ONLY the specified number of gold five-point stars on a genuinely TRANSPARENT square canvas. Copy the gold stars' existing plump five-point silhouette, dimensional bevels, broad clean facets, restrained highlights and dark golden edge. Each star has exactly FIVE outer points, one straight up. All stars must be identical size and material, each occupying about 36% of the square canvas width and height. Do not enlarge the stars in variants with fewer stars. Use the whole square as a fixed shared layout coordinate system; do not crop/recenter the occupied group independently. No plate, circle, backing, shadow blob, extra ornament, sparkle, text, letters, numerals or watermark. All empty space must be real alpha transparency, NOT a black/white/checkerboard background. Keep padding around every star and transparent gaps between stars. Output ONE standalone overlay sprite, not a comparison sheet. Exact layout: ONE star centered at x=50%, y=70% of the square canvas. No other star.

images.name: 中级
images.layout: TWO stars side by side on the LOWER row, centered at (28%,70%) and (72%,70%) of the canvas. Leave the upper row empty.
